description: This file defines a Migrator class responsible for migrating database collections and items within the Notesnook project. It includes methods for handling schema upgrades, data transformation, and progress reporting during migration.

classes.name: Migrator
classes.description: A class responsible for migrating database collections and items, handling schema upgrades, data transformation, and progress reporting.

methods.name: migrate
methods.description: Main method to perform migration of collections based on version, handling special cases for older versions and initializing collections.

methods.name: migrateToSQLite
methods.description: Helper method to migrate a batch of items to SQLite, skipping corrupted data and handling item state.

methods.name: migrateItems
methods.description: Helper method to migrate all items in a collection, managing progress, and handling item deletions and ID changes.
